Hear English as it\'s really spoken
PhonoTrainer shows how native speakers change words when they talk, and which of those changes you can copy.
Your clips become shorts
Share a video from YouTube or X, or pick one on this phone. Your computer analyzes it; your phone turns it into shorts you can swipe, slow down and repeat.
A few minutes a day
Each day you get a short set: listen, notice one change, say it back, then answer a few questions. A few minutes a day is enough.
Flapping
“water”
/ˈwɔtɚ/ → [ˈwɔɾɚ]
An example of a change: in “water”, flapping turns the t into a quick tap. Safe to produce.
